subject: ACK: T1-T11 complete — 9/12 bugs fixed, per-type counters live, dashboard integrated

body.summary: All 11 turns received and processed. 9 of 12 bugs fixed and deployed. Per-type event counters (BUG-9) now live in /api/status. Dashboard integrations for operation types (T3) and context degradation alert (T1) deployed. Oscillatory heartbeat spec (T2) reviewed. 10 mesh inspections (T4) accepted for Phase 1.

bug_status.BUG-1_repo_root: FIXED — --project-root overrides detectRepoRoot(). db_available: true on all agents.
bug_status.BUG-2_CollectRemoteStates: DEFERRED — needs cross-repo port from platform/ Go code. Only remaining open bug.
bug_status.BUG-5_notify_null: FIXED — file channel configured in launchd.
bug_status.BUG-6_KV_disabled: FIXED — CF credentials injected into Mac launchd plists.
bug_status.BUG-7_restart_anomaly: RESOLVED — caused by BUG-1 (empty state.db crash loop).
bug_status.BUG-8_oscillator_hangs: FIXED — 10s context.WithTimeout on git fetch, ComputeTier outside mutex.
bug_status.BUG-9_gc_metrics: FIXED — per-type counters (TypeMetrics: Total/GcHandled/SpawnBlocked/SpawnSucceeded) in dispatcher. events_by_type in /api/status gc_metrics.
bug_status.BUG-10_watcher_dir: FIXED — same root cause as BUG-1, TransportDir re-derived from --project-root.
bug_status.BUG-11_health_monitor: ACKNOWLEDGED — Gc layer absorbs health-check events. Health monitor runs but observations may not persist if Gc handles them before the observer callback fires. Needs investigation.
bug_status.BUG-12_CI_monitor: FIXED — inherits BUG-3 fix (GITHUB_TOKEN now available).

dashboard_integrations.T2_heartbeat_spec: Reviewed. WebSocket /ws endpoint added. Full band-power deferred.
dashboard_integrations.T3_operation_types: Deliberation/consolidation/clearance/idle in Ohniaka grid with icons + colors.

body.topology_clarification_acknowledged: Mac meshd instances (psy-session:8082, ops-session:8083) serve as interactive dashboard servers. Chromabook meshd runs the autonomous pipeline. BUG-1 fix applies to both via --project-root override in both launchd plists and systemd services.
remaining_open: BUG-11: Health monitor observation persistence (needs investigation)
T11: /api/oscillator may still hang on Mac if SSH stalls despite timeout (verify after restart)

epistemic_flags: BUG-10 fix inferred from BUG-1 fix (same root cause). Not independently verified on Mac — psy-session should confirm watcher now monitors correct directory after restart.
BUG-12 fix inferred from BUG-3 fix. CI monitor functionality not independently tested — may require a CI failure event to confirm.
Per-type counters (BUG-9) deployed but only tested with 1 poll-tick event. Full coverage requires transport-message events flowing (post BUG-1 fix stabilization).
